Masks a raster with another raster, or with thresholds on its values: the cells outside the mask, or outside the range of the thresholds, become no-data.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Mask, Threshold<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.CutOut`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The map that has to be processed. |
| `inMask` | raster file |  |  | The map to use as mask. |
| `pMax` | Double |  |  | The upper threshold value. |
| `pMin` | Double |  |  | The lower threshold value. |
| `doInverse` | boolean |  | `false` | Switch for doing extraction of the mask area or the inverse (negative). Default is false and extract the mask area. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The processed map. |
